parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal ban; anti-discrimination and hate-crime laws, one conviction, partial healthcare and a custodial-search recommendation give some protection. But the worst signals remain traveler-relevant once discovery occurs: 2024 police raid alleged torture/sexual assault with no reported sanction, repeated unsanctioned attacks on LGBT infrastructure, Pride security failures and political opposition, weak hate-crime enforcement. Borders, documents, facilities and emergency care for visitors are largely undocumented; silence is not safety. Because there is no universal facility ban, presentation offence or documented visitor-facing exclusion, it sits above severe-risk institutional exposure, but state tolerance/impunity and thin effective recourse place it in Elevated Risk.
